mcqs.question: What is a major distinguishing feature of Census 2027 in India?
options: It will be India's first digital Census and the first Census since 2011
It will be India's first paper-based Census and the first Census since 2011
It will be India's first digital Census and the first Census since 2015
It will be India's first digital Census and the first Census after 17 years from 2015
mcqs.explanation: Census 2027 will be India's first digital Census and the first Census since 2011. The tempting alternative that places the previous Census in 2015 is incorrect; the intervening Census was in 2011.

mcqs.question: According to the disability-inclusion data associated with Census 2027, how many UDID cards had been issued since 2015?
mcqs.explanation: Only 1 crore UDID cards had been issued since 2015. The closest distractor changes the starting year to 2011, whereas the stated period begins in 2015.
